# `discarded-error`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports an empty `catch {}` body.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Silently converting failure into success hides the original error and lets
execution continue with an unverified result.

## When it fires

Enable it when errors must be handled, propagated, or explicitly justified
rather than ignored.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn run() !void {}

pub fn main() void {
    run() catch {};
}
```

Reference: <https://ziglang.org/documentation/master/#Errors>
